reader.requirement: At --std 85 the item referenced by identifier-1 (an elementary alphanumeric item, a group item of any shape including one with an OCCURS DEPENDING ON table, a subscripted item, or an alphanumeric function under Amendment 1) is the area examined and split; its whole current image is the sending area, and its examination size is its current size.

edition-consulted.switches: a reference-modified sending operand (data-name, function or inline invocation) is the construct unstring-sender-reference-modified-2002: refused COBOL0900 below 2002 (§1985:VI.6.27.3 SR7), accepted at 2002+

reader.edition-search: Beyond the reference-modification gate: grep -i 'edition|version|dialect|DialectLevel' over StringUnstringBinder.cs, StringEmitter.cs, CobolStringOps.cs, OperandText.cs, FigurativeConstants.cs; grep -i 'unstring|delimit' over ConstructRegistry.g.cs and VersionConformancePass.cs. The binder's ctx.Edition uses are BoundRejected.Report/BoundOperandError.Report (the diagnostic channel, fixed EditionSeverity.Error) and ctx.Edition.At (the diagnostic cursor); neither switches behaviour. The only UNSTRING construct gate is unstring-sender-reference-modified-2002 (the sender, not this rule).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only the admissible spelling of identifier-1 differs (reference modification refused at 85, legal from 2002); the sending-area semantics are the one emitter path at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: da4 covers only a function sender; a group sender, an ODO group sender at two extents, a subscripted sender whose subscript the statement stores into, and POINTER at the last position and past the end are not exercised

probes.expected: GR2: a group's whole image (numeric leaf included), an ODO group at its current extent (6 then 4 characters), TE(I) identified once so the second field comes from TE(2) after I was stored; GR13a and GR17a pointer bounds

probes.printed: COBOL1651 sender 'SN' is category numeric; 'SA' category alphabetic; 'SE' category alphanumeric-edited; FUNCTION ORD category Numeric (plus COBOL1627)
probes.expected: §1985:VI.6.27.3 SR2: identifier-1 must be category alphanumeric; §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR3: only an alphanumeric function

probes.printed: COBOL0900 a reference-modified UNSTRING sending operand requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85); literal sender: COBOL5506 no literal is expected at this position
probes.expected: §1985:VI.6.27.3 SR7 refuses reference modification of identifier-1; the format admits an identifier only
FUNCTION REVERSE("AB,CD ") = " DC,BA" is the sending area (Amendment 1 alphanumeric function)

reader.notes: StringEmitter.SenderText reads the sender's image after IdentifyOperands has frozen its subscripts, and an ODO group renders at its current extent. At --std 85 the diagnostics quote the §2023 wording ('or national'), which affects only the message text. GR21 leaves overlap of identifier-1 with a receiver undefined, so the emitter's in-place re-read (LiveReads) is not judged here.

refuter.evidence: Probes under E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-115/src, run with run_case.py --std 85. u2.cob: group senders whose image holds a PACKED-DECIMAL S999 (2 bytes), a BINARY S9(4) (2 bytes) and a SIGN TRAILING SEPARATE S99 (3 chars) leaf, DELIMITED BY "C": COUNT IN 04 / 04 / 05 and R1 [AB05-], so the sending area is the storage image, not a rendering of the leaf's value (LEN 06 06 07). u4.cob: a 66 RENAMES RA THRU RB sender gives [AB] 02. k_1: PIC N sender refused COBOL0900 (national requires 2002); k_2: FUNCTION TRIM sender refused COBOL1502; k_5: FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE sender (Amendment 1 alphanumeric function) DELIMITED BY "1" gives [2026]. The reader's ODO, subscript and refmod probes stand. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.27.4 GR2 ("represents the sending area"); OK §1985:VI.6.27.3 SR4.
